notes.title: New update released today!
notes.content:
New update now available! (Patch notes 1.2.0.0)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954874/307b4cc121e3ab6fc86dea584ec60eed0d1c7f6d.jpg

GAMEPLAY UPDATES


 Shield with recovery rate added
 Visual points of damage in enemies


BUG FIXES


 FIXED - Camera behavior
 FIXED - Navigation in the Elevator Phase
 FIXED - Collision added in tires of the Waste Disposal map.



OTHER CHANGES


 One more dodge added
 Statistics added
 New difficulty (Hard mode)
 New illustrations of the game, unlocked at boss battles in hard mode
 New chibis
 New achievements
 New bosses attacks (Hard mode)

notes.title: We added a new mechanic changing the whole game feel
notes.content:
GAMEPLAY UPDATES


 Leviathan speed as robot augmented.
 Every time an effective dodge is executed, Leviathan will have an immediate charged shot to release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954874/2edace2ecbf3f8879ae8d10765ba3d626fb82711.gif


BUG FIXES


 FIXED - Bug in tutorial when not doing it in the right order.
 FIXED - Not being able to personalize the shoot button on the controller.
 FIXED - Bug in the New City when using the wipe skill.



MINOR CHANGES


 Loading screen.
 Minor fixes in the combat tutorial.
 Difficulty curve improved.
 Car sound stuck when ending a phase.
 Explosions added to bosses death.
 Improvement in the menu navigation with the controller.
 Snipers damage nerfed.
 The health of the tractors in the construction waste area nerfed.

notes.title: New Languages and Immortal Mode
notes.content:
We are proud to announce new translations for Bikini Alert. We included interface and subtitles for Spanish, Simple Chinese and Japanese. We hope to get many people from all over the Earth to play Bikini Alert.
In this update we added Immortal Mode AKA God Mode, perfect to memorize enemy attack patterns. Also, we added a new skill to wipes out the bullets around you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37954874/e12760a5f9c35d9075b8b566adeb4b3c5375442b.gif

Minor Fixes Notes:

 Aspect Ratio 
 Audio settings
